current_boundary.scope: Two clean-input states; not the full-PVT fixed-network current bound.

reference_scope: Controlled 1.23V across only the code15 112k+16*780 resistor string; ideal bypass of other trim segments. No switch MOS, Vbg loop, current mirrors or actual swing qualification.
geometry_scope: Calibrated signed A+B*L+C/L on the measured increasing branch, 0.01um grid; body-only film area excludes contacts/guards/routes.
current_density_scope: Prescribed 6.619mA local two-condition clean-input peak, assumed equal sharing; no fixed-network full-PVT current prediction or EM.
capacitance_scope: Port-effective PDK admittance at 2GHz with rail/body AC-grounded, not routed PEX. Reference series networks have distributed RC; RF inverse conductance need not equal DC slope.

primitive_layout_review.scope: Isolated generated 2p85 and 5p73 devices, nominal l=10um, 3-port guard; no network, PEX electrical qualification, EM or current capacity signoff.
